title: Onderzoek cron comment entity error
description: Cron error (2026-10-19): PluginNotFoundException 'comment entity type does not exist' in EntityTypeManager->getDefinition(). Comment module is niet enabled en geen stale DB-referenties gevonden. Vermoedelijk gewekt door een module-hook tijdens cron. Zoeken welke en fixen.
design: Root cause: Stale entries in Drupal state (field.field.deleted and field.storage.deleted) for comment_body on the comment entity type. The comment module was uninstalled but 'drush field:delete' or similar had already queued the comment_body field for cron purge. FieldPurger::purgeBatch() (web/core/lib/Drupal/Core/Field/FieldPurger.php:131) calls DeletedFieldsRepository::getFieldDefinitions($uniqueStorageId), which does array_filter with closure that calls FieldConfig::getFieldStorageDefinition() on EVERY deleted field. For comment_body: FieldConfig.php:304 calls entity_field.manager->getFieldStorageDefinitions('comment') -> EntityFieldManager::getBaseFieldDefinitions -> EntityTypeManager::getDefinition('comment') -> throws PluginNotFoundException. The first loop's isset() guard protects only itself; the array_filter in the storage-loop bypasses it. Reproduced locally with 'ddev drush cron'. Fix (applied locally): removed comment-targeted entries from state field.field.deleted + field.storage.deleted, dropped empty orphan field_deleted_data_41e50645a5 table, cleaned orphan key_value rows (entity.definitions.bundle_field_map/comment, entity.storage_schema.sql/comment.*, state/comment.maintain_entity_statistics). Production needs same fix via drush @prod ev once release approved.

title: translations:// directory niet correct geconfigureerd op prod
description: Deploy log toont: Failed to save file due to error "The specified file temporary://fileXxx could not be copied because the destination directory translations:// is not properly configured. This may be caused by a problem with file or directory permissions." 2 vertaalbestanden konden niet geimporteerd worden. Config: $settings[translation_path] of file_scan_ignore_directories ontbreekt mogelijk. Of filesystem permissions op web/sites/default/files/translations missen. Check settings.php en directory permissions.
notes: Root cause: translations:// stream wrapper resolve chain fails on prod during drush deploy. TranslationsStream::basePath() checks locale.settings translation.path (not set), then falls back to Settings::get('locale_translation_path', 'public://translations'). locale_translation_path was not set in settings.php, so it relied on public:// resolving correctly — which can fail on prod during deploy bootstrap. Fix: added Settings locale_translation_path = 'sites/default/files/translations' and Settings file_public_path = 'sites/default/files' explicitly in settings.php. SSH steps for prod: mkdir -p $DOCROOT/sites/default/files/translations && chmod 755 $DOCROOT/sites/default/files/translations && chown www-data:$USER $DOCROOT/sites/default/files/translations (adjust owner to webserver user). Also verify: ls -la $DOCROOT/sites/default/files/translations and drush eval "echo realpath(Drupal::service('file_system')->realpath('translations://'));"
close_reason: settings.php: added explicit locale_translation_path = 'sites/default/files/translations' and file_public_path = 'sites/default/files'. This ensures TranslationsStream::basePath() returns a path that does not depend on stream wrapper resolution during deploy. SSH steps for prod documented in notes: create/chmod the translations dir if missing, verify with drush eval.
